source.recipe: First 16 hex of SHA-256 over the following raw working-tree file bytes in this order, without separators, as qualify.js sourcesHash. No missing file is allowed by this approval.

sourceSelector.recipe: SHA-256 of raw CRLF bytes from const SOURCE_FILES = [ through ]; inclusive, excluding the following newline; preserve the exact ordered entries.

tool.recipe: SHA-256 of qualify.js raw working-tree bytes, NUL, qualification-records.js raw bytes, NUL, in that order.

attemptPolicy.recipe: SHA-256 of canonical JSON with recursively sorted keys, as qualification-records.js canon; qualify.js compares the full object.

machine.recipe: SHA-256 of canonical machineInfo(4) object with recursively sorted keys.

gitLineEndings.rawInputHashes: Checkout CRLF bytes; never substitute Git blob IDs for these SHA-256 identities.
gitLineEndings.manifestVerification: HEAD blob must exist; working-tree git hash-object must equal it. A diff-only check cannot establish authority.

host.comparison: Require the exact .NET StartTime string and separately the CIM UTC time truncated to microseconds, plus all other pinned fields. Do not compare the two seventh fractional digits.
host.newInstance: No admission until the orchestrator records the new full-tuple confirmation; never substitute a PID/name automatically.

supervisorCreationIdentity.match: PID plus creation time, run/cell/epoch and manifest identity

protocol.rowKey: variant/level; split these exact registered identifiers, never normalize or alias a cell
protocol.secondRound: Existing serial last-worker behavior; no scheduler repair or advance early-stop credit.
protocol.p95: Actual raw generation milliseconds; no subtraction, relaxation or repeated-result selection.
protocol.hits: exact and valid and solved and not approximate; bounded fallbacks are misses.

units.T: seconds of elapsed wall time, not CPU time
units.O: seconds of elapsed wall time per admission attempt

monitor.allOutcomes: Finite, non-negative ms, including successful and errored outcomes, not only timeouts.
monitor.Q: Unrounded qualifier finished-started, not its rounded seconds field.
monitor.S: Index-order dispatch on four simultaneously ready workers for round 1, plus the recorded serial second-round generation times.
monitor.W: Supervisor monotonic elapsed from owned Node launcher creation after lock acquisition until the whole owned payload tree exits, including readiness/startup/final output but excluding acquisition/gaps.
monitor.R: The same supervisor monotonic T-start-to-qualifier-creation interval, captured at the creation boundary before qualifier execution, not delayed observer/IPC receipt.
monitor.negativeQMinusS: Retain and pass this signed upper-bound check; the simulated schedule may be longer than the actual schedule.
monitor.wMinusQBelowR: Invalid timing, including any negative W-Q. Preserve record and stop further GQ for joint review of provenance and potentially affected request clocks.
monitor.canonicalValidation: Mandatory qualificationRecords.checkCell with manifest-derived expectations plus full header/protocol/round/key/seed/hit/summary checks; the optional reference callback alone is insufficient.
monitor.onBreach: Keep all evidence, stop subsequent GQ for joint Stage 2 review; never rerun a completed record.
stage3Tests: W-Q below R or above 60 rejected
clock origins/scopes and creation-boundary capture proved

admission.timeout: Unstarted hold, no qualifier; keep the reason and review stop. Not an eligible additional-consumer re-ask or a recovery authorization by itself.
admission.eligibleReask: Only a verified unstarted additional-consumer hold with no qualifier-launch intent; fresh slot and retained counters.
admission.foreignLock: No payload; never delete a foreign/live/uncertain lock or exempt another process tree.

required: three policy files and full policy object
freeze.allowedHead: The base or pack-only descendants of 42e0d239; inspect each intervening commit, not just its net diff.
freeze.workingTree: Authorized unhashed UI/locale/test/helper edits may remain uncommitted through GQ. They do not authorize any change to frozen inputs.
freeze.codeCommitBeforeGqComplete: Stop and obtain re-derived rows plus joint Stage 2 reapproval; the normal implementation commit follows task acceptance.
freeze.mismatch: No payload; retain evidence and require joint Stage 2 reapproval, never retag old records or reset the epoch/counters.
freeze.publication: difficultySupport edits only after the complete checked merge; qualification inputs stay frozen for all 135 cells.
freeze.manifest: Require HEAD:path to exist and git hash-object of the working-tree manifest to equal that blob; require both real approvals and S-OD13/S-OD14.

supervision.job: Non-inheritable kill-on-close Windows Job Object, create owned Node child suspended, assign then resume; no breakaway and no controlling handle inherited by children.
supervision.containmentProof: Short-lived Node parent forks four Node children; prove actual nested-job membership and all-owned-process exit on normal completion, T expiry and supervisor loss.
supervision.detachProof: Detached stand-in survives completion of its launching sub-agent; another agent/orchestrator adopts it by durable status and PID plus sourced creation time.
supervision.fallback: Only explicitly orchestrator-confirmed attached fallback with identical Job Object/deadlines; never uncontained.
supervision.TStart: Creation of owned Node launcher after lock acquisition, including suspended startup and readiness.
supervision.outputs: Project files and atomic status backed by append-only events, not a live shell pipe.
supervision.adopt: A live matching run keeps the same deadlines, ordinal and payload slot; never relaunch because an agent/shell disappeared.
supervision.lockCleanup: Orchestrator only, after proving the own-run supervisor dead, no owned process alive and the lock still bound to that exact instance.
supervision.forbiddenWrapper: No inherited drive.cjs 1800-second spawnSync or shared Invoke-Dv3Node 540-second route for GQ; audit every retained wrapper.
supervision.otherGates: Keep ordinary 450/540 protection; this route grants no CV6/E/GH/GD/GP/quick waiver.
supervision.duringPayload: Only approved payload/supervision bookkeeping, small file/status reads and the already-approved negligible Discord HTTP poller/report. No Node analysis/tests/hashing/formatting/aggregation, edits or optional CPU sampling.

recovery.counterKey: epoch + exact variant/level, with frozen input-tuple consistency
recovery.liveSupervisor: Adopt; no new admission or launch.
recovery.completeRecord: Never rerun, including valid early-stop, hidden, correctness or review outcomes; inspect every output/partial path before claiming no complete record.
recovery.diagnosis: Prior joint SA1/SA2 diagnosis of an eligible execution fault, exact retained evidence hash, and proof no live or complete primary remains.
recovery.authorizationCheck: Exists in HEAD, working-tree blob equal, both actual diagnosis approvals and explicit slot-2 admission budget; claim once durably before recovery admission 1.
recovery.canonicalReceipt: Copy a checked complete record's raw bytes once; retain origin/ordinal/hashes, never overwrite, stitch or select a faster repeat.
recovery.secondFailure: permanent-gap: recovery-exhausted; also applies to exhausted recovery admissions. No third payload/new grant/reset; complete publication remains blocked.
recovery.limits: Unchanged A/T/O; any revised limit separately needs joint S-OD13/Stage 2 approval without replenishing counters.
